name: YNAB
verdict_reason: Actual does zero-based budgeting with your data in a SQLite file you can read, and bank sync via SimpleFIN costs less than one month of YNAB per year.
what_you_lose: YNAB's first-party bank sync — Actual needs SimpleFIN Bridge (~$1.50/mo) or GoCardless for EU banks, one more account to hold
The YNAB method community, workshops and support humans
Nobody to email when a sync breaks the night before rent is due

what_broke: Silent exit where IPv6 is disabled: the server binds '::' by default, logs 'Listening' and then exits cleanly — ACTUAL_HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 fixes it, and the clean exit code makes it a genuinely nasty diagnosis
